title: Bruch-Quest
brief: Premium, Minecraft-inspired interactive Grade 6 fraction flashcards sourced from supplied German teaching PDFs, with progressive difficulty, light/dark modes, rewards, and encouraging topic feedback.

artboards.title: Quest trail
artboards.tradeoff: Most clearly communicates the source-backed progression; the active flashcard receives less persistent space.

artboards.title: Inventory cards
artboards.tradeoff: Makes individual learning cards and rewards tangible; less dramatic for hard challenges.

artboards.title: Boss arena
artboards.tradeoff: High motivational energy for difficult operations; unsuitable as the default entry screen.
